t: Bammeh modedin hattechumin umeqom hammedida umi hu hammoded
s: Bammeh modedin hattechumin umeqom hammedida umi hu hammoded ubo t"v seipim: en modedim techum hair ella bechebel shel pishtan shel chamishshim amma. Lo pachot, mippene shehu nimtach beyoter keshehu qatzar umaarik hammidda lelo tzorek (veken shel shear minim nimtach beyoter), velo arok yoter, mippene sheeno nimtach karauy, shekkobdo makpilo umitqatztzer beemtzaito umeqatztzer middat hattechum:

Im yesh lepanayv lesop a"h amma mehair nahar shehu rachab yoter mik"h amma, sheeno yakol lehablio bechebel shel n' amma kesheyyimdod bo missop chamishshim mehair, maqom shennistayyem hachebel paam achat — ketzad yaaseh? Leachar shemmadad n' amma mehair chozer laachorayv k"h amma, kede sheyyehe hachebel shel n' amma nishlam ad hannahar:
Lo yimdod ella keneged libbo, sheqqabeu lo chakamim maqom lasum kenegdo rosh hachebel, shello yitten zeh keneged tzavvaro vezeh keneged raglayv, vehachebel mitqatztzer vehattechumin mitmaatin:
Vetzarik limtoach hachebel bekol kocho, mippene shehu makbid beemtzaito:

Lo yimdod ella keneged hair. Apillu im yesh harim vegeot kenegdah lo yelek mikkenegdah letziddah shehu yashar veyimdod sham, veyachazor achar kak keneged hair lepi midda shemmadad sham, ella yimdod keneged hair kede lehablia heharim vegeot shekkenegdah, o lemodedah bederek sheyyitbaer:

Higgia lehar — im hu zaqup kol kak sheim yoridu chut hammishqolet merosho lo yitracheq mikkenegdo lematta beshippulo d' ammot, en tzarik limdod kelal hayrida vehaaliyya, ella im yesh mishor berosho — modedo, veim en mishor berosho — eno modedo kelal ella medallego legamre, ap al pi sheyyakol lehablio bechebel shel n' amma. Veim chut hammishqolet mitracheq mikkenegdo d' ammot, umitlaqqet y' tepachim mittok yoter mid' ammot, dehaynu shebbehilluk yoter mid' ammot shel shippua oleh y' tepachim begobah — az roim: im en missepato el sepato ella chamishshim amma beyosher, im hayu noqebim oto beshippulo etzel sepato vehayu modedim derek hanneqeb, azay tzarik lehablio bechebel shel n' amma, shezzoqep etz gaboah bispato mizzeh veetz acher kenegdo bispato mizzeh, umoteach chebel mizzeh lezeh. Veim eno yakol lehablio bechebel shel n' amma, modedo bechebel shel d' ammot, vekak yaaseh: echad omed beragle hahar lematta veechad lemala mimmennu berichuq d' ammot, venoten hattachton et hachebel keneged libbo vehaelyon keneged raglayv, veoleh hattachton lemaqom sheomed haelyon vehaelyon oleh d' ammot, umodedim kebattechilla, veken yaaseh ad sheyyimdedu kol hahar mib' tzedadayv, venimtza mitmaet midrono bekol d' ammot yoter min chatzi qomat adam, kemo shemmillibbo vead raglayv:

Veim hu meshuppa yoter shemmitlaqqet y' tepachim mittok d' ammot, kevan sheeno noach tashmish halikato, vetorach hu laalot velimtoach chebel meetz shebbispato mizzeh leetz shekkenegdo — azay lo hitrichuhu chakamim bekak, ella yeshaer beomed kamma yihyeh bechebel sheyyimtechu alayv meetz leetz im hayu maamidim otam bispatayv mizzeh umizzeh, veholek lo limdod lehallan lehashlim middat techumo. Veim shier bedato sheyyihyeh bo yoter min' amma, kevan sheim lo haya meshuppa kol kak haya tzarik limdod kol shippuo bechebel shel d' ammot — gam keshehu meshuppa kol kak lo heqellu bezeh leshaer beomed dato kamma yihyeh bechebel hammatuach, ella tzarik limdod kullo bechebel shel d' ammot:

Vekol zeh bahar, veken bekotel, ben shehu zaqup ben shennapal venaasa kehar. Abal im higgia legay, im yakol lehablio bechebel shel n' amma — tzarik lehablio velo leshaer beomed dato, apillu mitlaqqet asara mittok d' ammot, lepi shebbeqal yakol lehablio, sheechad yaamod mikkan veechad mikkan, veen tzarik lehaamid etzim kelal. Umittaam zeh apillu im en chut hammishqolet mitracheq mikkenegdo lematta d' ammot tzarik lehablio. Abal im eno yakol lehablio bechebel shel n' amma, im chut hammishqolet mitracheq mikkenegdo d' ammot — modedo kullo bechebel shel d' ammot kemo behar. Vehu shello yehe amoq yoter mealpayim. Abal im hu amoq yoter mealpayim — moded hayrida vehaaliyya shel kol hashshippua medida yapa kemo qarqa chalaqa, apillu im yakol lehablio bechebel shel n' amma. Veim en hachut mitracheq mikkenegdo d' ammot — eno moded kelal hashshippua shel yerida vaaliyya, ella hammishor shel matta bilbad im eno yakol lehablio, vaapillu im amoq yoter mealpayim:

Higgia lehar o legay, vekol mah shemmimmennu keneged hair hu rachab mechamishshim amma sheeno yakol lehablio, umin hatztzad hu mitqatztzer veholek, kegon shehu bemizrach hair vekol orek mizrach eno yakol lehablio — im yakol lehablio betok alpayim shel tzad tzapon o darom, yelek lesham veyablio, kevan shehu adayin betok hattechum shel tzad hair, veyachazor achar kak keneged hair lepi midda shemmadad sham. Abal im eno yakol lehablio betok alpayim shel tzad hair, lo yitracheq yoter lehablio, gezera shemma yomru haroim shemmiddat techumin baa lekan:
En somekin ella al medidat adam mumcheh shehu yodea middat haqqarqa:

Hayu lanu techume shabbat muchzaqin, uba mumcheh umadad, ribba bitchum mehem umiet bitchum mehem — shomeim lo ap bitchum sheribba, ap al pi shehu lehaqel, lepi shettolin lomar sheharishonim lo matechu hachebel kol tzorko, shetztzarik lemotcho bekol kocho:

Madad umatza middato bemizrachit tzeponit yetera al shekkenegdah bemizrachit deromit, moteach hachut shel simman hattechum mizzo lezo baalakson. Veen omerim shettaa beachat mehen, ella tolin shezzo shennitqatztzera hu mechamat harim vegeot sheyyesh sham, vehutzrak lemodedan beinyan shennitqatztzer hattechum. Veyesh omerim shettolin betauto, veholekin lehaqel lomar shettaa bezo shennitqatztzera etzlo, umotziin otah lehalea ad keneged haarukka (vehaiqqar kisbara harishona):

Im bau b' mumchim umadedu et hattechum, echad ribba veechad miet — shomein lammarbeh, lehaqel bedibre soperim, ubilbad shello yarbeh yoter mimmiddat alaksonah shel qeren hair. Ketzad? Beet sheyyarbeh zeh, nomar shemma ha' miqqeren alakson shel ir madad haalpayim gam ken baalakson, veken miqqeren shekkenegdah, venimtza keshemmotechim chut missup techum shemmiqqeren zo lesop techum shemmiqqeren zo yihyeh ben chut zeh leir pachot mealpayim, vehaacharon madad kahalaka metztzela hair. Veen machaziqin al harishon shettaa beyoter mishshiur zeh. Ulepikak im ribba haacharon yoter mishshiur zeh, en shomeim lo. Veshiur zeh hu shiur odep sheyyesh betzela arok alpayim al tzela merubba shealaksono hu alpayim, shehare min hair ad hachut hammatuach missop haalpayim shebbaalakson hu tzela merubba shealaksono alpayim. Veshiur tzela zo hu elep vetak"ch amma beqerub, lepi hacheshbon shel chakme hattalmud — shehu beqerub velo betzimtzum — bekol alakson, shehu odep al tzalot ribbuo b' chomashin meorek hatztzela, venimtza shemmeelep vetak"ch odep alaksono alpayim vetatan"v chomashin, shehem tqa"b amma pachot d' chomashim, tenem al elep vetak"ch — yihyu alpayim amma pachot d' chomashim. Abal lepi cheshbon chakme hammiddot, sheddiqdequ vetzimtzemu hacheshbon bekol alakson, yihyeh odep zeh tqp"h amma beqerub:

Osin hattechumin sabib hair ketabla merubbaat, dehaynu shemmoded al pene kol orek hair lemizrach alpayim amma lechutz, veken letzapon, veachar kak roim keillu hayeta tabla merubbaat alpayim al alpayim beqeren lemallotah, venimtza hattechum baqqeren alpayim vaalakson, shehem alpayim vet"t, veken yaaseh bishar haqqeranot. Abal lo yimdod meemtza haqqeren alpayim baalakson veken beqeren shekkenegdah veyitten hachut mizzo lezo, sheim ken mapsid hat"t shebbeqeren, vegam lo yihyeh hattechum keneged hair ella elep vetak"ch, ulepi cheshbon chakme hammiddot elep vetat"v:

Apillu ebed veshipcha kenaanim, sheqqibbelu alehem mitzvot shehaishsha chayyebet bahen, neemanim lomar "ad kan techum shabbat", shello ameru chakamim et haddabar lehachamir ella lehaqel. Abal qatan eno neeman beodo qatan. Abal neeman haggadol lomar "zakur ani shead kan hayinu baim beshabbat keshehayiti qatan", vesomekim al eduto:
